description: This Java source file defines the CreateOrderFromCartFlow class, which orchestrates the checkout process by retrieving a cart, validating it, reserving inventory, calculating totals, applying discounts, calculating taxes, creating an order, and authorizing payment. It implements a comprehensive checkout flow for an e-commerce system.

classes.name: CreateOrderFromCartFlow
classes.description: A service class that orchestrates the entire checkout process from cart validation, inventory reservation, total calculation, order creation, to payment authorization for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to orchestrate the checkout process from retrieving the cart to authorizing payment, returning a detailed checkout result.

methods.name: validateCartMatchesRequest
methods.description: Validates that the cart's details match the provided request parameters.

methods.name: reserveInventoryOrThrow
methods.description: Reserves inventory for all items in the cart, throwing an exception if reservation fails.

methods.name: mapCartToCreateOrder
methods.description: Maps cart response data to an order creation request.

methods.name: calculateSubtotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal price of the cart items by resolving prices through the pricing service.

methods.name: resolveUnitPriceOrZero
methods.description: Resolves the unit price for a SKU, returning zero if unavailable.

methods.name: normalizeStoreCode
methods.description: Normalizes the store code string to a standard format.

methods.name: stableStoreIdLong
methods.description: Creates a stable long ID from the UUID store ID for API compatibility.

methods.name: authorizePaymentOrThrow
methods.description: Performs payment authorization with PayPal and throws if it fails.

methods.name: buildPaymentIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Builds a deterministic idempotency key for payment requests to ensure safe retries.

methods.name: toMinorUnitsOrThrow
methods.description: Converts a BigDecimal amount in major currency units to minor units as a long, throwing on failure.
